[center][color=#93c47d][size=6][font=Verdana]A Horizontal Progression Rogue-Like Mod for Stardew Valley[/font][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=6][font=Verdana][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50772/50772-1786845615-815149173.png[/img][/font][/size][/center]
[center]

[size=4][font=Verdana][color=#D4D4D8]Blightfall adds a tonne of daily surprises to your farm: a random[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]crop that sprouts overnight, small monster ambushes, seasonal[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]mini-bosses, a once-a-year full monster wave, a daily "blessing" you[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]choose each morning, mild curses picked up from lingering monsters,[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]mysterious mail rewards, a traveling merchant, meteor strikes, lucky[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]days, and a friendly visiting rabbit. It also places a[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]"Blightfall Obelisk" on your farm which, on demand, summons[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]progressively tougher waves of monsters around itself for money,[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]loot, and (on a 5-clear streak) a powerful week-long boon.[/color][/font][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#6aa84f][size=5]Daily Systems[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[code]All of these roll independently every morning a quiet day for one doesn't affect the odds of any other.

- Random Morning Crop (every night) A random crop valid for the current season is planted and grown to maturity by morning.

- Monster Ambush (25% chance/day) 2-3 weak monsters sneak onto the farm, 5+ tiles from your door. Loot chance per kill, plus a random weapon dropped nearby. Uncleared ambushes despawn with no reward the next day.

- Seasonal Mini-Boss (12% chance/day, max once per season) A tough monster (2.5x HP) appears. Beat it before bed for a great reward — sleep first and it vanishes, reward lost.

- Yearly Monster Wave (4% chance/day, max once per year) A full raid: 6 monsters up front, +3 more at set checkpoints through the day. Fight for loot, or sleep early to end it (unclaimed kills give nothing).

- Mysterious Mail (7% chance/day) An anonymous letter delivers 250-1000g or a random weapon.

- Traveling Merchant (6% chance/day) Sets up near your farmhouse for the day with 5 random rare items (warp totems, Iridium Band, Vampire/Savage Ring, Ring of Yoba, Deluxe Fertilizer, Battery Pack, Treasure Chest).

- Meteor Strike (5% chance/day) A meteorite leaves an ore-rich resource clump to mine.

- Lucky Day (8% chance/day) Boosts your shared daily luck better odds on treasure and rare forageables.

- Friendly Visitor (8% chance/day, doubled for 3 days after an obelisk clear) — A rabbit wanders onto the farm — interact with it for a gold gift (25-75g normally, 75-150g during the post-clear bonus window)[/code]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50772/50772-1786845615-815149173.png[/img]
[center][color=#93c47d][size=5]Daily Blessings[/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50772/50772-1786847820-1000508639.png[/img][/center]
[code]Each morning you pick one blessing from a random set of options; it lasts until you next sleep. 70+ are in the pool, covering:

- Combat stats: Attack, Defense, Speed, or Immunity boosts, plus riskier hybrids like Berserker's Rage (+Attack/-Defense) and Glass Cannon (+Attack/-Defense, bigger swing)

- Combat mechanics: bonus weapon speed, precision, critical chance, critical power, and knockback, alone or combined (e.g. Deadly Precision, Whirlwind)

- Skill levels: temporary level boosts to Farming, Fishing, Mining, Foraging, or Combat — including multi-skill blessings like Renaissance Farmer (+2 to four skills at once)

- Utility: Max Stamina, Luck, and magnetic pickup radius

Bonus blessing: if you contract a curse and clear every monster on the farm that same day, you have a 50% chance of a second blessing the next morning.[/code]


[center][color=#93c47d][size=5]Curses[/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50772/50772-1786847820-1133663685.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[code]Curses are mild, temporary hexes picked up from monsters lingering on your farm. Each monster present adds a small chance per tick (4% each, capped at 30% per check) of landing a random curse, a stat penalty (Attack, Defense, Speed, Luck, Immunity, Stamina, a skill level, or a combat mechanic like weapon speed/precision/crit) that lasts until every monster on the farm is cleared, with a 28-day hard expiry as a safety net. There are 33 in the pool, ranging from single-stat dips (Weakness, Fragile, Unlucky) to small combos (Off Balance: -weapon speed and -Defense).

Curses don't start appearing until day 30, so new farms get a grace period. Clear a curse the same day you get it, and you're in the running for a bonus blessing the next morning.[/code]


[center][color=#6aa84f][size=5]The Blightfall Obelisk[/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=5][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50772/50772-1786847825-1670570256.png[/img][/size][/center]
[code]What is causing the blightfall? Why are strange things happening around my farm? Well, you will eventually find that out.

- A custom obelisk is placed somewhere open on your farm (6+ tiles from your door) it looks like the vanilla Mini-Obelisk but has none of the warp behavior; everything about it is this mod's own. If it's ever broken or picked up, a replacement appears elsewhere automatically (checked every second, so there's no real downtime).

Summoning a wave: interact with the obelisk to spawn monsters around it.

- Starts at 4 monsters, +1 per wave cleared, capped at 16.
- Bosses can appear from wave 3 onward — 8% chance, +4% per wave cleared, capped at 65%.
- You can't summon a new wave while the current one is still alive.
- A HUD tracker shows live progress ("Wave number and Wave progress:eg. 2/5 cleared").
- Obelisk has its own loot table, and pre-balance pass has begun. No more earning 100k+ in later waves.

Rewards:

- Clearing a wave pays 60g base + 30g per wave number — later waves pay substantially more.
- Each kill has a chance at bonus loot.
- Monster max health now scales up 15% per wave cleared (Capped at triple base health)
- 5 waves cleared in a row = a random week-long Obelisk Boon (see below).
- Die mid-wave, and you wake up cursed until you clear another one.
- Clearing a wave also doubles your Friendly Visitor odds and improves its gift for the next 3 days.


OBELISK BOONS (weekly streak reward)

Earned by clearing 5 consecutive obelisk waves — roughly double the strength of a daily blessing, lasting a full week. 35 are in the pool:

- Combat stats: big Attack, Defense, Speed, or Immunity boosts, plus aggressive hybrids like Obelisk Fury (+Attack/-Defense) and Obelisk Berserker (+Attack/-Speed)
- Combat mechanics: large boosts to weapon precision, crit chance/power, weapon speed, and knockback — including multi-mechanic boons like Obelisk Duelist and Obelisk Executioner
- Skill levels: heavy multi-skill boosts (Obelisk Mastery, Obelisk Polymath) or single-skill specialist boons (Obelisk Farmhand's Zeal, Obelisk Angler's Grace, Obelisk Prospector's Fortune, Obelisk Forager's Wisdom)
- Utility: large Stamina, Luck, and magnetic radius boosts
- All-rounder: Obelisk Champion (+Attack, +Defense, +Speed, +Immunity all at once)[/code]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip the `Blightfall` folder into your `Mods` folder, same as any other SMAPI mod.

[b][size=4]Found a bug? [/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]Please leave a detailed bug report and i will look into it, let me know which mods may be causing conflicts, this is still early into development, and some things may not be as polished as they should be.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Balancing?[/size][/b][/color]
While i am trying to keep everything somewhat balanced from the get go, this mod is meant for fun. There are safety checks in place for new farms to make sure you don't get destroyed right off the bat!

[size=4]Compatibility?[/size]
[size=3]I try to make everything self contained, nothing that damages vanilla systems. Should you run into any compatibility issue with another mod, please submit a bug report and i can try and investigate. [/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=6]Saves?[/size][/color]
[color=#6aa84f][size=6]I always recommend backing up your save when playing with early alpha mods. I also recommend playing this on a new save. If you want to play it on your current save, [/size][/color][color=#a61c00][size=6][u]please make sure you back up prior to use[/u][/size][/color][color=#6aa84f][size=6] as future changes could introduce bugs. If you run into anything gamebreaking, please revert saves and submit a bug report and how to reproduce the issue. This was tested thoroughly on a new and old save, but i am only one person. As said within the compatibility notes, this is self-contained, not touching vanilla systems outside of balance. Uninstalling should not cause any issues. If it does, please submit a bug report.[/size][/color]

Manifest.Name: Blightfall
Manifest.Description: Blightfall (Alpha .01). Each morning, a random crop sprouts on your farm, a small monster ambush may appear, and you choose from many daily blessings. Seasonal mini-bosses, a yearly monster wave, mysterious mail rewards, mild monster-borne curses, a traveling merchant, meteor strikes, lucky days, and a friendly visiting critter round it out. A small obelisk on your farm summons waves of monsters around itself when interacted with, growing tougher (with occasional bosses) and more rewarding each time you clear one — five clears in a row earns a weekly boon, and falling in battle curses you until you clear another wave.
